notes.title: Patch note 1.0.0.8
notes.notes:
Fix : 
- Fixing once and for all the bus crash
- Adjust the conflict between background gradients at the end
- Fixing the bug where the score doesn't stop after gameover
- Delete first top score in ladder : 
name : BUG
score : 55 471 443

Update map :
- Fixing some layer issue 
- Adding some elements
- Rework of last road ( was a bit harsh )

Add :
- Adding "START TO SKIP" in the tutorial


Multiplayer :
- If things weren't clear, it's possible to play with controller and keyboard simultaneously. For exemple you can setup things as : 1 player on controller and 2 players on keyboard or 3 players on controllers and 1 player on keyboard.


Thanks and take care.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
FIx : 
- set WASD as default keyboard input

 - Fixing critical issue with interaction between monkeys and bus

 - Fixing sucess huge dip

 - Change score buffer when gameover
 
- Change score display in ladderboard
 
New :
 - Add a sub menu when quitting the game from pause menu
 
 About controller : 
 - if the game doesn't detect your controller, try to desactivate steam input in the game settings. The game uses an input library that can deal with most controllers.

 - for remotePlay on the other hand, Activate steam input can solve some problems.

Keyboard Input :
numpad 3 -> START player 2
F8 -> scretch width display
F9 -> scretch height display
F11 -> fullScreen



Thanks to all players. every reports on ideas and problems are very much appreciate.
Enjoy and see you soon.
